# OpenTimestamps test files

Copied unchanged on 2026-11-16 from the reference client's published
examples, github.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client, folder
examples/, so the reader is tested against proofs it did not write.

| File here | Original name | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| ots-bitcoin-912095.ots | gdp2q25-2nd.pdf.ots | A complete proof to Bitcoin block 912095 |
| ots-two-calendars.ots | two-calendars.txt.ots | Pending at two calendars |
| ots-pending.ots | incomplete.txt.ots | Pending at one calendar |
| ots-ripemd160.ots | hello-world.txt.ots | A path through RIPEMD-160, which is refused |

Block 912095's Merkle root, 936131994129988e1932d8c1c6a9780fd42ae4c87204cfb0ac852be1250039ae
(display byte order), was read from blockstream.info/api/block/ on
2026-11-16.
